normalization.toolSet: multiset; duplicate calls count as false positives unless explicitly expected
normalization.argumentObjects: extra fields are incorrect unless schema-default-equivalent
normalization.arrays: ordered except featureFields/select sets where the case declares semantic set equality
normalization.dynamicReferences: must equal the exact value emitted by the named upstream call
normalization.finalClaims: must be supported by recorded tool results

argumentFieldScoring.correct: expected field exists with correct type and semantic value
argumentFieldScoring.incorrect: missing, wrong type, wrong value, fabricated identifier, wrong dataset/field/time/filter/environment
argumentFieldScoring.denominator: all expected leaf fields plus every unexpected supplied leaf field

metrics.singleToolTaskSuccessRate: PASS single-tool cases / all determinately scored single-tool cases
metrics.argumentAccuracy: correct argument leaf fields / all scored argument leaf fields
metrics.toolSetF1: micro 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), using the best matching explicitly acceptable multiset per case
metrics.multiToolTaskSuccessRate: PASS multi-tool cases / all determinately scored multi-tool cases
metrics.workflowSuccessRate: PASS workflow cases / all determinately scored workflow cases
metrics.orchestrationAccuracy: correct required dependency edges and conditional branches / all scored required edges and branches

casePassRules: Observed tool multiset matches one acceptableToolSets entry.
Every deterministically checkable expected argument and result assertion passes.
Every required dependency edge and branch is satisfied.
No failed or ABSTAIN review is represented as formal delivery.

statusRules.FAIL: model chose/called incorrectly, supplied wrong arguments, violated dependency/safety rules, or made an unsupported final claim
statusRules.ABSTAIN: evidence is insufficient to decide a required semantic assertion and no deterministic failure is already present
statusRules.INFRA_ERROR: registered tool/runtime/service/credential/fixture failed independently of model behavior

antiLeakage: scenario and oracle hashes frozen before execution
no Golden edits after first model launch
